title: Germany and France — stable comparison facts / Германия и Франция — проверенные факты
content: Germany and France are both members of the European Union and the euro area. Germany is a federal parliamentary republic composed of 16 states. France is a unitary semi-presidential republic. Metropolitan France is larger in area than Germany. Germany is especially strong in manufacturing, machinery, chemicals and automotive production; France has major services, aerospace, luxury goods, agriculture, tourism and manufacturing sectors. Германия и Франция являются членами Европейского союза и еврозоны. Ключевые слова: главные отличия Германии от Франции, членство в ЕС.
source: European Union country profiles and national constitutional summaries

title: NOVIX privacy and recommendation principles
content: NOVIX recommendations must respect account blocks, restrictions, search visibility, private-profile settings and the user's AI recommendation controls. Radar ranking is deterministic and explanations must be derived only from profile and activity signals.

title: NOVIX identity
content: NOVIX is a platform for meaningful human connection, professional networking and personal growth. Its product name is NOVIX and its visual identity uses the technological letter N.
